context: Request: every M&A matter where a no-shop or exclusivity covenant made it into an executed definitive agreement or a standalone executed exclusivity agreement (not LOIs, term sheets or drafts), with those agreements. Rubric: 21 matters (1001-00003/4/5/7, 1002-00004 exclusivity-agreement.docx in a Series D financing, 1003-00003/4, 1006-00006/8, 1007-00006, 1008-00008, 1009-00003, 1017-00006, 1018-00008, 1032-00005, 1037-00006, 1038-00009, 1039-00004 executed offer to purchase, 1041-00003, 1042-00004, 1046-00001), each with its proof document, plus precision.

stages.note: Path regex for covenant and deal-agreement words, plus a file grep capped at 240 lines and a folder grep capped at 200.

stages.note: Reads about 25 executed agreements and exclusivity letters of candidate matters, then snippet scripts over the executed agreements on its strong-hit list. The review flags many surfaced matters never opened.

stages.note: declared: Screen candidate matters by reading documents (attempt 2). A script run with no stage open is refused; then a store-wide script over executed-looking deal agreements for covenant headings (278 hits).

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes 21 matters with executed agreements and covenant sections, excluding a financing matter's standalone exclusivity agreement as non-deal work.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Attempt 2: compares the two agreements, restores the removed matter as distinct and re-checks paths.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.failure_point: It never opened one matter whose covenant sits in an executed offer to purchase, although that matter surfaced in its scan lists, and it excluded a standalone executed exclusivity agreement because the deal was a preferred-stock financing.

first_error.why: A matter whose covenant sits in an executed offer to purchase surfaced in its candidate lists at [36] and [42] (and again at [85]), but none of its reads or snippet scripts opened it.
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) The screening review at [79] said many surfaced matters were never opened, naming others; the agent ran one more scan and a few reads, not of this matter.

other_errors.why: Its snippet script at [76]-[77] showed a standalone executed exclusivity agreement in a financing matter, but the answer excludes the matter as non-deal work.

runs.failure_point: Its store-wide scan reached every matter, but it kept only hits with explicit no-shop or competing-proposal wording, so executed agreements whose covenant is worded otherwise (several purchase agreements, an offer to purchase) were never read; it also excluded a financing matter's executed exclusivity agreement.

first_error.why: The background scan at [46]-[51] hit all 266 matters, but the filter at [54] kept only explicit no-shop or competing-proposal wording or exclusivity file names, dropping seven matters whose executed agreements word the covenant otherwise; the answer was built from the filtered list.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The review at [57] said the filter would drop executed agreements that word the covenant differently; the agent screened only the filtered list.
first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script

other_errors.why: Its snippet script at [71]-[72] showed a financing matter's standalone executed exclusivity agreement, but the answer excludes the matter as a preferred-stock financing.

divergence: All fail, in different ways and at different stages. T1 ended in context overflow at an uncapped store-wide snippet script, before any review. T0 found 19 of 21: it never opened one matter that surfaced in its candidate lists (surfaced-not-opened at the first screening stage; flagged only in generic terms). T2's scan reached every matter, but a wording filter dropped seven, and it screened only the filtered list (over-narrow-filter, flagged specifically and ignored). T0 and T2 both excluded the financing matter's executed exclusivity agreement as non-deal work, with no review comment. In T0 a check review caught a late edit that removed a qualifying matter, and the agent restored it.
